Name: Complete me! ME!!

Text: [b][color=64ffff][lb]Check][/color][/b] Gain +1 [b][color=ffffff]Power[/color][/b] for every unique Ailment & Debuff on the target.

PostText: [b][color=ffffff][lb]After Use][/color][/b] If this skill evades every enemy Die, another ally may use a skill with a Cost of 1 or lower against the same target without using a [b][color=ffaa64]Speed Die[/color][/b]. They must still spend [b][color=ffeecc]Light[/color][/b] as normal. During this attack, the target may only respond with saved Dice.
